description: Implementation of the MtpStringBuffer class for handling UTF-8 and UTF-16 string conversions, reading from and writing to MtpDataPacket objects, and managing internal string buffers within the Android media framework.

classes.name: MtpStringBuffer
classes.description: A class for managing UTF-8/UTF-16 string buffers, including encoding, decoding, and serialization/deserialization with MtpDataPacket.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the buffer content from a C-style string or a UTF-16 string, updating character and byte counts.

methods.name: readFromPacket
methods.description: Reads a string from an MtpDataPacket into the buffer, decoding UTF-16 data.

methods.name: writeToPacket
methods.description: Encodes the buffer content into UTF-16 and writes it into an MtpDataPacket.
